exposure: Persistent hyperextension of the fetal craniocervical junction
cohort: Four fetuses with extreme fetal neck hyperextension on prenatal ultrasound and subsequent MRI
finding: Detailed, high-resolution fetal MRI can help guide clinical decisions regarding pregnancy management, in utero therapy, mode of delivery, and postnatal care in cases of extreme fetal neck hyperextension.
mod_finding: Three out of four patients with persistent extreme neck hyperextension underwent caesarean section with early intubation due to concerns about airway compromise and cervical cord injury.
